Forge the Future Hackathon 2026 | Hiring Challenge

Presented by Elastic, powered by AWS, is inviting India's AI builders to develop autonomous, explainable, production-ready AI agents across Search, Observability, and Security.

1. ₹6,00,000 Prize Pool
2. Mentorship from Elastic & AWS experts
3. Potential career opportunities with Elastic for eligible participants.

Apply now: https://hackculture.io/hackathons/forge-the-future-hackathon-2026?ref=Sct3

Application Deadline: 16th August 2026
